hypothesis: ensureInventoryLevels (line ~185) compares each reservation input's quantity against the level's available_quantity independently, never summing inputs that share an (inventory_item_id, location_id). Cart A (5 x OVS-PIECE) and cart B (3 x OVS-PIECE + 2 x OVS-TWOPACK, i.e. 7 WIDGET units) both complete together against stock 10. Each cart's aggregate is checked only in the per-line loop, so when A reserves 5 first, B's lines (3 and 4) each pass against 5 remaining, leading to reserved 12 of 10 and a negative available quantity. I expect no_oversell to fail in some runs, while reserved_matches_reservations should still hold since the counter is written consistently in a single process.
